title: Aidan Hutchinson: It's "extremely liberating" to focus on football with injury behind me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Aidan Hutchinson: It's "extremely liberating" to focus on football with injury behind me
sources.description: A year ago, Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson was full-go in training camp, but he was still focused on recovering from the broken leg that had ended his 2024 season.
